messages:
pagerbot: PD ALERT PD-12456 fired — High 5xx rate detected for services: inference-gateway, model-proxy (5xx rate > 8% over 3m). Graph: https://observability/redwood/alerts/PD-12456 :rotating_light:
eng-oncall: acknowledging — oncall taking this. jumping in.
sam: saw a canary deploy ~15m ago (commit abc123). canary weighted 10% to inference-gateway:v2. might be related.
maria: any customer impact yet? which regions?
priya: EU-west1 showing most of it. error spike concentrated on requests to model-proxy when kv-cache misses spike. 5xx breakdown: 502/503 from proxy and 504 from gateway. ~420 5xx/min at peak.
ryan: logs show repeated timeout to backend model-server-0: "upstream timed out" and a bunch of 5xx OOM-ish traces. model-server cpu usage is normal but GC looks suspicious.
eng-oncall: plan: 1) pause canary 2) redirect traffic off model-proxy to fallback variant 3) scale up dedicated pool for EU 4) follow up with revert if not recovering.
eng-oncall: pausing canary now — `redwood deploy traffic set inference-gateway:v2 0%`
ops-bot: command accepted — traffic weight updated. Canaries: inference-gateway:v2 -> 0%.
sam: thanks. will start rolling back the deploy if we don't see improvement in 2m.
priya: enabling temporary routing rule to send model-proxy calls to model-proxy-fallback (quantized small) for EU: `redwood routing update --service model-proxy --region eu-west1 --route fallback-quant`
ops-bot: routing change queued. will apply in ~30s.
maria: FYI customer-impact: initial check with observability -> ~12% of EU requests returned 5xx in last 5m. no widespread outages yet but a few large enterprise tenants in EU saw increased failures. +1 to escalate to CS for customer outreach.
ryan: adding a temporary autoscale: `kubectl scale deployment model-server --replicas=6 -n prod-eu` to reduce contention while we investigate.
eng-oncall: scaled model-server replicas to 6. warming up cache.
priya: cache warm-up started. also turning off aggressive KV eviction: `KV_CACHE_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.9` on model-proxy for EU via config rollout.
sam: rolling back the canary fully now: `redwood deploy rollback --service inference-gateway --to previous`
ops-bot: rollback started (deploy id d-98321). ETA ~45s per pod.
pagerbot: PD escalation: PD-12456 escalated to SRE lead due to >5m sustained high 5xx.
maria: pinging support to message affected customers, include mitigation steps and ETA 30m for full recovery.
ryan: dev note: model v2 exposes a heavy GC path under certain request patterns (long context). fallback has shorter context and is holding. we should limit seq_len on gateway for v2 until we fix.
eng-oncall: temporary rule: reject requests >8k tokens for v2 and reply with structured fallback. applying now.
priya: KV eviction threshold change applied, routing to fallback live, rollback underway. metrics show 5xx rate dropping from 420/min -> 120/min in last 2m.
sam: good sign. keep monitoring. if stabilization continues for 10m we'll close PD and follow up with postmortem.
ops-bot: deploy rollback completed. all inference-gateway pods on previous stable revision.
maria: CS alerted. posted advisory in internal CS channel and queued outbound notes for affected tenants.
pagerbot: PD-12456 update: incident marked INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATING. attachment: https://observability/redwood/incidents/PD-12456/graph.png
eng-oncall: metrics trending: 5xx now ~40/min, error-rate eu-west1 ~1.3%. continuing to monitor for 20m.
priya: leaving a sticky note to engineering: follow-up actions: patch GC path, add regression test for long-context load, revisit cache eviction policy and canary weight ramping.
ryan: creating ticket RN-4587 for GC fix and RN-4588 for canary ramp playbook.
maria: thanks all — closing loop with CS in 15m. once stable for 20m we can mark as resolved.
sam: ack, will keep watch.
eng-oncall: marking incident as recovering. will update PD in 20m if no reoccurrence. :white_check_mark:
